description: Resume an interrupted dance from the .dance-state.json checkpoint in the applications root. Single step: it drops the template-docs alignment that the full spernakit-dance recipe runs first and calls the dance skill directly, leaving the checkpoint to decide what still needs doing. Always set the resume args from the checkpoint before launching: the default is a placeholder, and Part A begins with A1, which ships a new template release.
name: spernakit dance (resume)

parameters.description: Resume arguments for the dance skill. Read <applications-root>/.dance-state.json and pass --resume-from matching its phase, plus --scope/--pilot agreeing with its scope when narrowing. --resume-from A re-runs A1 and re-ships the template; only use it when the template ship really is unfinished. Do NOT pass a bump hint: a bump hint that disagrees with the checkpoint makes the skill archive the checkpoint and restart the whole dance from Phase 0.
parameters.name: resumeArgs
